notes: Both articles are emptied by a free genitive μου under rule 20; each μου is unspent elsewhere in its phrase, so rule 76's availability test is satisfied and the article realizes nothing.

The ψωμίσω unit heads on *bestow*, the word standing in the verb's own slot and governing the Greek object. Heading on *feed* as the more direct gloss of the lexeme remains defensible under rules 17 and 91, and the unit already records the competing added reading of *the poor* under rules 5 and 103.
The projection carries καυθήσομαι, which *to be burned* translates; the ASV's *that I may glory* note is a textual note only and no new decision is made here (rule 12).
